trigger_cases.prompt: Reconcile daily card network settlements and calculate state tax nexus withholding.
Generate an automated dispute evidence package for a fraud chargeback.
Calculate municipal transient occupancy tax and VAT for marketplace bookings.
Center the checkout submit button and add credit card brand icons.
Set up an OAuth login flow with Google.
Optimize SQL query execution time on the transactions table.

binary_cases.prompt: Design an automated payout and settlement reconciliation engine for a two-sided marketplace.
binary_cases.pass_rule: Enforces dual-entry double-entry ledgering with idempotency keys and escrow holdbacks before disbursement.
binary_cases.pass_fixture: Implement an idempotent double-entry ledger with unique idempotency keys, holding funds in escrow until carrier delivery verification before disbursing payouts.
binary_cases.fail_fixture: Use a single-entry ledger to directly disburse without reconciliation and ignore duplicate webhook retries.

binary_cases.prompt: Handle sales tax, VAT/GST, and marketplace seller tax compliance across US and EU jurisdictions.
binary_cases.pass_rule: Tracks economic nexus thresholds, calculates jurisdiction-specific taxes (VAT/GST, US state sales tax, local occupancy taxes), and generates 1099-K / DAC7 reporting records.
must_not: leave all tax liability entirely to unverified sellers
binary_cases.pass_fixture: Monitor economic nexus thresholds per jurisdiction, dynamically withhold and remit state sales tax and VAT, and automatically compile annual 1099-K and DAC7 tax reporting records.
binary_cases.fail_fixture: Assume flat 0% tax across all transactions and leave all tax liability entirely to unverified sellers without monitoring nexus.

binary_cases.prompt: Compile a compelling chargeback dispute response for an unrecognized transaction claim.
binary_cases.pass_rule: Assembles transactional metadata, carrier proof of delivery with GPS/signature, customer IP/device fingerprint, and terms of service consent into a structured dispute packet.
binary_cases.pass_fixture: Assemble a dispute packet containing carrier proof of delivery with GPS tracking, the customer's IP address and device fingerprint, and timestamped terms of service checkout consent.
binary_cases.fail_fixture: Accept chargeback without reviewing evidence or submit empty dispute notes.
